symptoms.label: No reliable way to reach the driver
symptoms.root_cause: Passengers cannot get a working response or contact channel from the driver, whether messages are ignored, calls fail, or the app gives no usable instructions. Provide a dependable recovery contact path and prompt driver responses to lost item reports.

symptoms.label: Belongings remain outside the passenger's control
symptoms.root_cause: Items remain unrecovered because drivers fail to return them, keep them, leave with them, or cannot confirm where they are. Improve item handling and make driver inspection and return commitments traceable.

symptoms.label: Support process does not resolve recovery
symptoms.root_cause: Account access barriers, premature case closure, stalled follow-up, and slow handling of urgent items prevent passengers from completing recovery through support. Keep cases open until the item is confirmed returned and prioritize essential belongings.

dropped_causes.label: Passenger cannot place required phone call
dropped_causes.description: Lack of calling credit or phone dialing limitations prevents the passenger using the required telephone recovery channel.

dropped_causes.label: Driver conditions return on payment
dropped_causes.description: The driver demands money before returning the passenger's belongings.

dropped_causes.label: Subsequent passenger may have taken item
dropped_causes.description: The requester suspects a later passenger took the item and needs investigation or identity information.

dropped_causes.label: Wrong belongings collected at exit
dropped_causes.description: A passenger accidentally takes someone else's item and needs to arrange its return.

dropped_causes.label: Unsafe driver identity obstructs recovery contact
dropped_causes.description: A mismatch between the driver and profile photo makes the passenger afraid to contact the driver for recovery.

dropped_causes.label: Driver withholds cash fare change
dropped_causes.description: The driver keeps the passenger's cash fare change instead of returning the balance.
